cannotFail.text: This test cannot fail on a wrong result: nothing in it calls Error, Errorf, Fatal, Fatalf, Fail or FailNow on a *testing.T, and it hands the test to no helper that could. Only a crash in the code under it can fail it, so go test reports it as passing whatever result that code returns, and its silence reads as a proof it never gave. Check what it computes and report a mismatch with Errorf or Fatalf, or delete it if there is nothing to check.
